photography.goldenHourNotes: Oaxaca sits in a mountain valley at 1,500m — the light is clear and golden, especially in dry season (Nov–May). The Zócalo glows beautifully at dusk when the church is lit. Market photography works best before 9 AM when vendors set up.

weather.seasonality: Dry season (Nov–May) is ideal. Rainy season (Jun–Oct) brings daily afternoon showers — mornings stay clear. The famous Guelaguetza festival is in July.
weather.summary: Pleasant year-round highland climate. Warm days, cool evenings. Dry season (Nov–May) is ideal for travel.
